description: Decide whether serverless inference is affordable before committing to it: estimates token and GPU cost against the wallet balance and returns a verdict. Use before create_serverless_endpoint when deploying a model, and before run_serverless_job on anything large or repeated — deploying an endpoint commits to standing capacity, so the check belongs there too, not only at invocation. Checking the wallet balance directly answers a smaller question: it says what is available, not what this will cost. Read-only and free; it never deploys an endpoint or invokes one.
name: should_i_run_pel_job
